data.name: Stunning Stab
data.description: At 19th level, when a swashbuckler hits a creature with a light or one-handed piercing melee weapon, she can spend 2 panache points to stun the creature for 1 round. The creature must make a DC %1 Fortitude saving throw. If the creature fails, it is stunned for 1 round. Creatures that are immune to critical hits are also immune to this effect.|SwashbucklerStunningStabDC
